newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $7.00/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $7.00/T.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has lowered its bunker fuel prices by $7.00 per tonne effective January 24, a company statement said on Friday.

Posted prices for 180, 280 and 380 centistoke bunker fuel delivered at the ports of Keelung, Hualien, Taichung and Suao were decreased by $7.00 per tonne, to $127.00. Term prices were also cut $7.00 to $124.00 per tonne.
Spot and term bunker C grade were also lowered by $7.00 to $125.00 and $122.00 respectively.
CPC is Taiwan's monopoly supplier of bunker fuels.
